title: AI Release Frequency Per Month
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Capability Tracking
description: Line chart of new AI models shipped each calendar month since November 2022, showing month-to-month release cadence.

learningObjectives: Read a noisy monthly time series
Distinguish short-term volatility from long-term trend

keyQuestions: Which months had unusually high or low release counts?
Why doesn't a slow month mean AI progress is slowing down?
commonMisconceptions: Reading a single low month as evidence the overall trend has reversed
assessmentOpportunities: Ask learners to distinguish noise from trend using this chart

dataSource.name: AI Release Tracker
dataSource.note: Chart values live in ../ai-release-data/data.json, shared with five other MicroSims.
